from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyTaxInfo(BaseModel):
    """One company's tax payable information from a single financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as it appears in the report")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The security/trading code if provided, e.g. '000635'")
    tax_payable: float | None = Field(description="The amount of taxes payable (应交税费) from the balance sheet, in yuan")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024 年第一季度'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_tax_info_list: list[CompanyTaxInfo]
